companies.name: Redshred
companies.tagline: AI for technical documentation, search, and procedural guidance.
companies.description: Redshred turns technical manuals and other complex documents into searchable, structured information using AI and machine learning. Its COACH product supports procedural guidance. In July 2026 the company announced selection for a BlueTIDE demonstration; that announcement establishes selection, rather than confirming the later demonstration took place. Its company profile lists Catonsville in Baltimore County.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Catonsville address listed on the company-maintained profile.
companies.meta_description: AI for technical documentation, search, and procedural guidance.

companies.name: Mindgrub
companies.tagline: Baltimore AI consulting, custom software, copilots, and workflow automation.
companies.description: Mindgrub is a technology consultancy headquartered on East Fort Avenue in Baltimore. Its current services include AI strategy and implementation, copilots, triage agents, decision systems, and fractional AI leadership. It is a services firm for organizations adopting AI, rather than a single-product AI startup.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · headquarters at 1215 East Fort Avenue.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore AI consulting, custom software, copilots, and workflow automation.

companies.name: Fearless
companies.tagline: Baltimore digital services with AI, data engineering, and human-reviewed automation.
companies.description: Fearless is a Baltimore digital services company whose data practice includes AI and machine learning, predictive modeling, natural-language processing, and conversational AI. Its published projects include drafting museum image descriptions and permit-related content with human review. These examples establish specific AI work without implying that every Fearless project uses AI.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · company identifies its home in Baltimore.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore digital services with AI, data engineering, and human-reviewed automation.

companies.name: Tenable
companies.tagline: Columbia-based exposure management with agentic AI for cybersecurity workflows.
companies.description: Tenable is an exposure-management company headquartered in Columbia, Howard County. Its Tenable One platform includes Hexa AI. On May 20, 2026, Tenable announced work with Anthropic on Claude-powered workflows and agentic capabilities. This is a Greater Baltimore cybersecurity company; its Columbia headquarters should not be described as a Baltimore City office.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Columbia headquarters, Howard County.
companies.meta_description: Columbia-based exposure management with agentic AI for cybersecurity workflows.

companies.name: ZeroFox
companies.tagline: Baltimore external cybersecurity company using AI analytics; privately held since 2024.
companies.description: ZeroFox provides external cybersecurity services and AI analytics, with headquarters on Whetstone Way in Baltimore. Haveli Investments completed its acquisition on May 13, 2024, and the company was delisted. Older accounts of ZeroFox as a publicly traded company need that ownership update.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · current headquarters listed on Whetstone Way.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore external cybersecurity company using AI analytics; privately held since 2024.

companies.name: Huntress
companies.tagline: Managed cybersecurity and an AI-centric security operations platform, based in Columbia.
companies.description: Huntress offers managed endpoint and identity security and says its platform is backed and operated by an AI-centric security operations center. Its current contact and privacy pages list a Columbia address. The company operates with a distributed team, so its regional base should not be read as a count of employees working locally.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Columbia contact address; distributed workforce.
companies.meta_description: Managed cybersecurity and an AI-centric security operations platform, based in Columbia.

companies.name: CyberPoint International
companies.tagline: Columbia AI strategy, model development, and MLOps through the AIZEN team.
companies.description: CyberPoint International lists its headquarters in Columbia, Maryland. Its AIZEN team offers AI strategy, model development, and machine-learning operations. The current headquarters information supersedes older descriptions placing the company in Baltimore City.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Columbia headquarters at 7142 Columbia Gateway Drive.
companies.meta_description: Columbia AI strategy, model development, and MLOps through the AIZEN team.

companies.name: Leidos (Greater Baltimore operations)
companies.tagline: Regional agentic AI development through Leidos company Kudu Dynamics in Columbia.
companies.description: Leidos is a national technology company with documented AI work in Greater Baltimore. A May 2026 Kudu Dynamics recruiting page identifies an onsite Columbia role building agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent workflows. This supports a regional operating presence, not a Baltimore headquarters claim. A job posting is evidence of the role described at publication; it does not guarantee a vacancy remains open.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore operations · Columbia role documented; parent headquarters outside Baltimore.
companies.meta_description: Regional agentic AI development through Leidos company Kudu Dynamics in Columbia.

companies.name: Axle
companies.tagline: Maryland AI and research services firm with documented federal laboratory work in Baltimore.
companies.description: Axle provides AI services including language models, computer vision, analytics, and MLOps. A company-managed 2026 laboratory posting documents onsite support for the National Institute on Aging in Baltimore. The local laboratory work and company-wide AI practice are separate verified facts; the posting does not show that every AI capability is deployed in that Baltimore lab.
companies.location_note: Baltimore research operations · federal laboratory work; not a local headquarters claim.
companies.meta_description: Maryland AI and research services firm with documented federal laboratory work in Baltimore.

companies.name: PGDx, part of Labcorp
companies.tagline: Baltimore-origin genomics business using machine learning in cancer-testing analysis.
companies.description: Personal Genome Diagnostics became part of Labcorp in February 2022. Labcorp describes machine-learning algorithms and automated data curation in PGDx elio testing solutions. PGDx has documented Baltimore roots and current Labcorp recruiting identifies Baltimore work. Historical corporate materials list Boston Street; we do not treat that older address as a freshly verified office location.
companies.location_note: Baltimore-origin acquired business · local work documented; historical street address not reverified.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore-origin genomics business using machine learning in cancer-testing analysis.

companies.name: Protenus, acquired by Bluesight
companies.tagline: Baltimore-founded AI compliance analytics business, acquired by Bluesight in 2025.
companies.description: Protenus developed AI-based healthcare compliance analytics and was acquired by Bluesight on January 9, 2025. Its patient-privacy solution was subsequently renamed PrivacyPro. This entry preserves a Baltimore-founded company’s history while identifying its current parent and product identity. A current independent Protenus headquarters has not been verified.
companies.location_note: Baltimore-founded · acquired business; current independent local office not verified.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore-founded AI compliance analytics business, acquired by Bluesight in 2025.

companies.name: Sonavex
companies.tagline: Johns Hopkins spinout developing ultrasound and AI for dialysis-access visualization.
companies.description: Sonavex is a Baltimore company spun out of Johns Hopkins. Its April 2025 announcement describes EchoMap combining 3D ultrasound and AI to visualize dialysis access before cannulation, and reports FDA 510(k) clearance. EchoMap must be distinguished from EchoMark and EchoSure: the company currently labels those products investigational and unavailable commercially for AV-access use. Product clearance is not evidence for every proposed clinical benefit.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · Johns Hopkins spinout, as identified by the company.
companies.meta_description: Johns Hopkins spinout developing ultrasound and AI for dialysis-access visualization.

companies.name: b.well Connected Health
companies.tagline: Baltimore connected-health platform offering AI navigation and interoperable patient data.
companies.description: b.well Connected Health lists a Baltimore address and offers conversational AI and natural-language care navigation. In July 2026 the company announced its CMS Aligned Network was live. CMS independently describes the network as operating in production in an August 5 update. That confirms network activity, not the clinical effectiveness of b.well’s AI products.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · legal contact at 145 West Ostend Street.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore connected-health platform offering AI navigation and interoperable patient data.

companies.name: JuneBrain
companies.tagline: Baltimore retinal-imaging AI for research; investigational use, not clinical diagnosis.
companies.description: JuneBrain develops AI analysis of retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging. Its current company page identifies Baltimore headquarters and collaborations with Johns Hopkins and the University of Maryland, Baltimore. The company advertises a 2026 AI-powered OCT analysis pilot. Its products and services are for investigational use only and are not for clinical diagnosis.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · headquarters confirmed on the company’s about page.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore retinal-imaging AI for research; investigational use, not clinical diagnosis.

companies.name: Welldoc
companies.tagline: Columbia digital-health company with an AI Lab focused on cardiometabolic care.
companies.description: Welldoc develops digital-health technology and maintains an AI Lab for research, data science, and AI-enabled support for cardiometabolic care. Its US office is in Columbia, Howard County. Welldoc’s AI Lab describes collaboration with Johns Hopkins. This listing describes the company’s work without independently evaluating clinical or commercial performance.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · US office at 10221 Wincopin Circle, Columbia.
companies.meta_description: Columbia digital-health company with an AI Lab focused on cardiometabolic care.

companies.name: Infinite Biomedical Technologies
companies.tagline: Baltimore prosthetic-control company with documented machine-learning development.
companies.description: Infinite Biomedical Technologies (IBT) develops prosthetic-control technology and traces its origins to Johns Hopkins. Its current team includes machine-learning engineering, and its office is at 8 Market Place in Baltimore. FDA’s AI-enabled-device list includes the Sense System with IBT Electrodes. That establishes a specific AI-enabled product history; it does not mean every current IBT product uses AI.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · office at 8 Market Place, Suite 500.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore prosthetic-control company with documented machine-learning development.

companies.name: Mind Over Machines
companies.tagline: Owings Mills AI integration, business automation, and workforce adoption consulting.
companies.description: Mind Over Machines helps organizations integrate AI into business workflows, including chatbots, machine learning, and natural-language processing. Its services combine software integration, automation, and workforce adoption. The company lists its office in Owings Mills, Baltimore County.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Owings Mills office at 10451 Mill Run Circle.
companies.meta_description: Owings Mills AI integration, business automation, and workforce adoption consulting.

companies.name: Catalyte
companies.tagline: Baltimore talent and technology company using predictive AI in talent discovery.
companies.description: Catalyte identifies Baltimore as its headquarters and describes using predictive technology to identify potential technical talent beyond traditional credentials. Its services include apprenticeships, technology consulting, and AI advisory work. Claims about the predictive effectiveness of its system are company claims; this directory does not independently validate hiring accuracy or bias reduction.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · headquarters identified in the company FAQ.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore talent and technology company using predictive AI in talent discovery.

companies.name: Enveil
companies.tagline: Fulton privacy-preserving software for encrypted analytics and machine learning.
companies.description: Enveil develops software for privacy-preserving searches, analytics, and machine learning across organizational boundaries. Its ZeroReveal ML offering includes encrypted federated learning. The company-maintained profile lists Fulton, Howard County. On September 2, 2026, Enveil announced Carahsoft as its public-sector distributor, expanding distribution channels for its secure data-use software.
companies.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Fulton address from the company-maintained profile; described broadly as DC metro on its site.
companies.meta_description: Fulton privacy-preserving software for encrypted analytics and machine learning.

companies.name: EcoMap Technologies
companies.tagline: Baltimore AI resource mapping and conversational navigation for local ecosystems.
companies.description: EcoMap Technologies develops AI-enabled resource mapping and conversational navigation tools for economic-development organizations, chambers, and other ecosystem builders. TEDCO identifies EcoMap as Baltimore-based and announced a Seed Funds investment of more than $100,000 on June 22, 2026. That amount describes the TEDCO investment, not necessarily the total financing round.
companies.location_note: Baltimore City · location identified by TEDCO in June 2026.
companies.meta_description: Baltimore AI resource mapping and conversational navigation for local ecosystems.

companies.name: Pixee
companies.tagline: AI application-security triage and code remediation, with a Baltimore company base.
companies.description: Pixee develops AI tools for triaging application-security findings and producing code fixes. Its company-maintained profile lists Baltimore as headquarters and an additional location in Palo Alto. This supports a city-level company connection; a current staffed Baltimore street address has not been independently verified.
companies.location_note: Baltimore headquarters per company-maintained profile · also lists Palo Alto; local street address not independently verified.
companies.meta_description: AI application-security triage and code remediation, with a Baltimore company base.

resources.name: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
resources.tagline: Applied AI, autonomy, and mission-focused research at Johns Hopkins APL in Laurel.
resources.description: Johns Hopkins APL conducts applied AI and autonomy research across national security, space, and health-related missions. The laboratory is in Laurel, not on the university’s Homewood campus in Baltimore. Its April 2026 account of in-house language-model training provides a concrete example of current AI research. Public articles and careers pages are useful entry points; campus access and eligibility depend on the specific opportunity.
resources.location_note: Greater Baltimore · Laurel, at 11100 Johns Hopkins Road.
resources.meta_description: Applied AI, autonomy, and mission-focused research at Johns Hopkins APL in Laurel.

resources.name: Johns Hopkins Mathematical Institute for Data Science
resources.tagline: MINDS connects theoretical data science with language, vision, robotics, and other research.
resources.description: MINDS is the Johns Hopkins Mathematical Institute for Data Science. Its work covers foundations of data analysis and applications including computer vision, language and speech processing, robotics, and medicine. Its site links to research, education, and seminars. MINDS and the broader Data Science and AI Institute are distinct organizations; use the relevant program’s own page when planning a visit or applying.
resources.location_note: Johns Hopkins University · Baltimore research community.
resources.meta_description: MINDS connects theoretical data science with language, vision, robotics, and other research.

resources.name: Johns Hopkins Data Science and AI Institute
resources.tagline: Johns Hopkins AI research, education, and interdisciplinary events in Baltimore.
resources.description: The Data Science and AI Institute supports research and education across fields including neuroscience, medicine, climate, and public-sector innovation. Johns Hopkins announced construction of its new Homewood buildings for 2026, with completion scheduled for 2029. The buildings are a future facility, not an already-open campus hub. Current institute programs and events operate through the university’s published locations.
resources.location_note: Baltimore · university-wide institute; new Homewood buildings under development.
resources.meta_title: Johns Hopkins Data Science and AI
resources.meta_description: Johns Hopkins AI research, education, and interdisciplinary events in Baltimore.

resources.name: UMBC Center for Artificial Intelligence
resources.tagline: UMBC AI research, faculty, labs, seminars, and educational opportunities.
resources.description: UMBC’s Center for Artificial Intelligence connects research, applications, and education across the university. Its current website provides faculty and laboratory directories, AI news, opportunities, and an event calendar. UMBC’s main campus is in Baltimore County near Catonsville. Official university pages disagree on whether the center was established in 2023 or 2024, so this listing does not assign a founding year.
resources.location_note: Greater Baltimore · UMBC main campus, Baltimore County.
resources.meta_description: UMBC AI research, faculty, labs, seminars, and educational opportunities.

resources.tagline: UMBC research park supporting AI, cybersecurity, health technology, and business growth.
resources.description: bwtech@UMBC supports companies from early concepts through growing businesses across AI, cybersecurity, health technology, and other technical fields. Its current website provides program, company, and event information. It is a broad technology research park rather than an AI-only accelerator, and event access or program eligibility should be checked with the organizer.
resources.location_note: Greater Baltimore · research park at UMBC, Baltimore County.
resources.meta_description: UMBC research park supporting AI, cybersecurity, health technology, and business growth.

resources.name: Pava Marie LaPere Center for Entrepreneurship
resources.tagline: Johns Hopkins founder programs, formerly known as FastForward U.
resources.description: The Pava Center is the current identity for the Johns Hopkins entrepreneurship center previously known as FastForward U. Its programs serve student, alumni, and community ventures, with separate eligibility rules. Spark, Fuel, and the Social Innovation Lab are entry points listed on its site. It supports a wider range of ventures than AI alone.
resources.location_note: Baltimore City · Johns Hopkins entrepreneurship community.
resources.meta_description: Johns Hopkins founder programs, formerly known as FastForward U.

resources.name: TEDCO
resources.tagline: Maryland technology funding and commercialization support, with Baltimore-region programs.
resources.description: TEDCO supports technology and life-science entrepreneurship across Maryland. Its Maryland Innovation Initiative connects participating universities with commercialization support, while the Baltimore Innovation Initiative focuses on the region. A July 2026 announcement reported another BII award round. Program participation and funding depend on the current eligibility and application requirements, not simply on being an AI company.
resources.location_note: Statewide Maryland resource · based in Columbia.
resources.meta_description: Maryland technology funding and commercialization support, with Baltimore-region programs.

resources.tagline: Baltimore startup support, funding connections, and an active technology portfolio.
resources.description: ETC Baltimore supports technology and biotech entrepreneurs in Baltimore City through funding and ecosystem connections. Its current site lists a South Charles Street address. resources.description: Techstars AI Health Baltimore connects health-technology founders with Johns Hopkins, CareFirst, MedStar, the University of Maryland, Baltimore, and the University of Maryland Medical System. Its current page lists a November 18, 2026 application deadline for a program scheduled to start March 8, 2027. Participation in a Baltimore cohort does not establish a company’s headquarters in the region; check the live program page for changed dates.
resources.location_note: Baltimore accelerator · participating startups can be headquartered elsewhere.
